findings_fixed: Both modes: the weapon-set switch compared the other set with the current weapon's options affordable at that moment. Real time lists them during the cooldown but they were skipped; turn-based builds none once the standard action is spent. Camellia switched seven times, each 'against 0', every time with her standard action spent; in turn-based fight 2 she switched to the crossbow (3.4/rd) after Inspired Rage and ended her turn, the greataxe's Move+Attack having been 10.8. The current weapon is priced by its options whatever the moment allows, else its price earlier this turn (WeaponSetRules); with neither, no switch. An attack after the switch this turn needs the standard action.

Both modes (author-approved): arcan (Arcanist 4) and Aeiluvetar (Guardian 5) were drained to death in real-time fight 9 by a Corpulent Spectre (2 levels a touch) and a Cairn Wight Rogue (1 a hit), arcan at 98 % HP. The game kills at negative levels = character level (UnitLifeController.ForceTickOnUnit). A withdrawal was offered only below half HP. Half or more of the levels drained now counts as badly hurt (TacticalEngine.BadlyHurt, ValueModel.HalfDrained): the withdrawal is offered and walks pay exposure, priced as before. The header names 'drained N/L'.
